strings:
A watch page built from ordinary HTML, for Noctiluca's frame pacing
     tests and measurements: a header, a playing 30 fps test card
     (media/card.webm, ffmpeg's own pattern, made by media/make_card.py)
     in a player whose clock and progress bar this page's script updates
     on `timeupdate` (as a site's player does, so the page changes several
     times a second while it plays), a title, comments and related videos.
     Local: no network, no third-party assets.
A test card at thirty frames a second
1,234 views. A generated pattern, looping, for measuring how evenly frames arrive.
